13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __wherein the contact elements are positioned on an outer surface of the second portion and extend in a direction generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage__.

14. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body __that surrounds at least a portion of the flexible tube and is thermally isolated from the heater__.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __via a snap-fit or clip mechanism__.

16. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body __such that the heater is positioned between the flexible tube and the insulating sheathing body__.

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising an inner layer in contact with the flexible tube and an outer insulating layer__.

18. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __having a heating element embedded within the tube wall__.

19. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __as a resistive heating wire wound around or embedded within the flexible tube__.

20. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection __that is separate from the respiratory gas passage and the contact elements__.

21. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __that is fluidly connected to the flexible tube__.

22. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __that delivers water vapor to the respiratory gas__.

23. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube __and includes a heating element to warm the humidified gas__.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __that provides structural support while maintaining flexibility__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __that is powered by direct electrical connection via the contact elements__.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements are made of a conductive material that maintains electrical contact under repeated connection and disconnection__.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion __and is electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction perpendicular to the longitudinal axis__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements are made of a conductive material and are positioned on an outer surface of the second portion__.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion __and is electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction perpendicular to the longitudinal axis__.
